images.name: 余烬·金牛
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one premium fantasy weapon concept illustration for an original Skyrim mod, one of four distinct Taurus zodiac bows.
Composition: portrait 2:3 illustration, one complete tall bow only, centered with generous margins, both limb tips and the entire taut bowstring visible, near-side orthographic view with a slight three-quarter angle to show real thickness. A clean charcoal-black studio background, no scenery, no person, no hands, no arrows, no secondary weapons.
Art direction: beautiful ambitious yet buildable SIMPLE GEOMETRIC SOLID-LIGHT construction. Substantial thick rectangular/prismatic luminous beams, clean polygonal facets, interlocking triangles/trapezoids/rhombi, strong negative space. Every rail is visibly thick and sturdy, no hair-thin latticework. Recognizably a functional recurved BOW: a comfortable unobstructed central grip, continuous upper/lower limbs, and a taut string connecting their ends behind the grip. Bull-horn silhouette and strength express TAURUS; NO coiled ram horns, no spirals. No six-pointed star, no pentagram, no central obstructing medallion.
Materials: colored hard light with brighter edge cores and moderately dimmer faces, no metal, no gold hardware, no realistic animal head, no gems, no leather or wood. Restrained tasteful fluorescent halo, saturated colored faces stay readable, no white-hot blown-out bloom, no large lens flare. Fine product-concept painting with crisp geometry, real bevels and depth, not a wireframe, not a screenshot. Some deliberate colored particle accents illustrate a proposed draw effect, clearly smaller than the weapon and leaving the silhouette and aiming lane clear. Particle accents are concept art, not proof of game simulation.

Distinct design: BULL CROWN / broad armored architecture. Two bold non-spiraling polygon bull horns sweep OUTWARD and then sharply UP from each wing shoulder, upper and lower mirrored as parts of the bow. Large overlapping solid triangular red wedges gradually taper along a muscular recurve. A thick twin backbone connects the horn shoulders to split arrowhead-like limb tips. The horns are a strong open U shape, ending in short angular points, not closed curls. Dominant crimson and vivid scarlet with restrained hot rose-red edge cores; no yellow/orange metal. Draw-effect proposal: a few sharp red triangular embers lifting between the paired horn shoulders, tiny scarlet sparks streaking outward. Graphic silhouette must feel powerful, deliberate, substantial.
Text: at the bottom, a single small elegant readable Chinese caption exactly "余烬·金牛". No other text.
